item.title: [SYNTHETIC] Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
item.description: The Federal Open Market Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point. Inflation has moved closer to the Committee's 2 percent objective. The Committee judges that downside risks to employment have increased.

item.title: [SYNTHETIC] Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement and implementation note
item.description: The Federal Reserve issued an implementation note following the FOMC statement lowering the target range for the federal funds rate.

item.title: [SYNTHETIC] Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement action with Example Bank
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board announced the termination of an enforcement action with Example Bank.

item.title: [SYNTHETIC] Federal Reserve Board releases results of supervisory stress test
item.description: Large banks remain well capitalized under the severely adverse scenario. Projected losses were higher than last year due to weaker credit card performance.

item.title: [SYNTHETIC] Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee
item.description: Participants noted that labor market conditions had softened. Several participants saw upside risks to inflation from tariffs.
